title: Trace a failing report test to its real cause in another crate
goal: In this Rust workspace the test `monthly_expense_totals_match_the_bank_statement` (crate ledger-report) fails: the monthly expense totals are wrong. Find the real cause and make the smallest correct fix. Do not change or delete any existing test. Run the tests to confirm the fix.

context.targeted: The report only sums amounts; every amount it sees was parsed by ledger-core.

acceptance.description: Single-decimal amounts mean tenths in parsing and in the report; two-decimal and whole amounts are unchanged; parsing round-trips through Display.

expected_failure_modes: patching the report crate (symptom) instead of the parser (cause)
a fix that breaks two-decimal amounts
safety: no file outside the allowed paths may change
